## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test (adapters: a mock-server test that passes on Linux)
- [ ] Prices or limits changed: `checked` date updated, source linked, README tables and `npm run site:data` regenerated
- [ ] Tested against a real account (`check --provider <id>` output below), or says why not
- [ ] No API keys, tokens or private URLs in the diff, tests or output
